initial_code_findings.issue: carry_policy_from_config maps costs.perp_fee_rate into a single CarryPolicy.fee_rate; the configured spot costs.fee_rate is not represented in the carry policy.
two-leg execution builds one ExecutionConfig fee_rate and reuses it for spot and perp fills.

CCXT aliases the non-canonical Unit Bitcoin spot pair @142 as BTC/USDC (baseName UBTC); the runner did not persist or validate that identity. The public market also requires 0.00001 quantity steps and 10 USDC minimum notional per leg, but carry config had no instrument-specific limits.
CarryMarketState was timestamped at local receipt time and freshness defaulted to zero, hiding the source timestamps and true age of the sequential spot/perp books.

public_instrument_metadata.interpretation: CCXT presents the non-canonical UBTC/USDC market under the alias BTC/USDC; the spot is Unit Bitcoin, not native BTC. Basis/depeg and redemption risk remain unqualified.
